notes.title: V1.4.4 "Tutorial" Update!
notes.content:
Greetings from a new update of Mad Miner!

Even though I'm calling this update a “tutorial” update, you might remember that Mad Miner already has a tutorial. So why is this update called “tutorial”?

Because... With this update, Mad Miner now has a much more polished tutorial that new players will love!

The old tutorial map was a rather boring shade of gray and not something we would want to play with. But now we have a new tutorial map with more vibrant colors and more readable text!

[h3]Let me show you the difference with the images below:[/h3]

This is a frame from our old and boring tutorial map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/5681e5f8d1a37e0b1a4f729b2f77c349f2e29c6b.png[/img]

This is our completely revamped tutorial map with new narratives!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/b93d8c6e44371f65e354a234fe3472f0ca1f3855.png[/img]

Ahh... This new map is really warming me up...

I hope the new tutorial map will help you get into the game faster and enjoy the unique world of Mad Miner!

There are also a few fixes and additions with this update:
[list]
[*]The ESC menu differences on different maps were ugly and this has been made as pleasant as possible.
[*]The number indicators for block selections in the terrain editor, which I don't even remember why they exist, have been removed.
[*]In previous updates, I included the unique interfaces of each crafting table, including the indicators of the graves that appear when we die, but I realized that I didn't include the new version I drew in the updates... 😅. Anyway, it's now included!
[*]Added zooming in on your character when you press the R key. Maybe it was a feature I added in case I shoot a video, but I think it will be useful for you too.
[/list]
Thank you for playing Mad Miner or adding it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Hook Gun Madness!
notes.content:
As I'm developing Mad Miner 2, I have great news for all you Mad Miner players!

Welcome to our first ever in-game event! If you like this kind of events, I plan to make more of them.

[b]During this limited-time event: Hook guns, which you normally have a 50% chance of getting in the desert mines, will now have a 100% chance of being deep in the desert mines waiting for you to collect them![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/c365a6a48aaacef7c68c7fa1c0f29b1e99e808a7.png[/img]

So what is a hook gun and what does it do?

Hook guns allow you to travel horizontally and vertically very quickly and perform acrobatic stunts in mines without fear of getting trapped! 

Hook guns do not have a lifespan. So owning even one means you can use it forever! I still recommend collecting more during this event and having a spare grappling gun waiting for you when you die.

Be careful when hunting for grappling hook pistols! An uncanny enemy will be waiting for you!

So open the Mad Miner and journey into the desert!

notes.title: Endless Replayability Fest - 50% Discount
notes.content:
[h1]A festival of endless replayability definitely describes Mad Miner![/h1]

[h3]And why?[/h3]

Mad Miner is a procedurally generated game in which you continue to survive and build your shelter in randomised mines one at a time. While there is a general flow and an ending, it is also possible to live your own story in Mad Miner.

You can either start out extremely poor with a customised shelter or extremely rich, or you can start surviving in a pre-made bunker by making adjustments in architect mode. If you want to get even crazier, you can also experience survival in a fully customised mining terrain thanks to the terrain editor.

Since Mad Miner supports decoration blocks modding and custom maps, you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/p3et787xhz]discord[/url] and download maps or provide more decor possibilities with decoration blocks. Of course, you can also design all of these yourself and include them in the game.

[h3]Buy once and play infinitely![/h3] 

Mad Miner has a structure that will fully justify this sentence. If you get bored with the survival mode, you can prepare hook parkours for yourself with the hook gun or struggle on extremely difficult running parkours.

If Mad Miner seems complicated to you at the beginning, please do not hesitate and try to understand the structure of Mad Miner by familiarising yourself with the game with the tutorial section and testing items in the architect mode. If you find that it is the kind of game you are looking for, believe me, Mad Miner will easily become one of your favourite games.

Don't be intimidated by a strange inventory structure where all your items appear in the inventory. You can learn all the items there gradually and understand what you need to use them for with the "short" description in the description boxes.

Thank you for your time and interest in Mad Miner. Please feel free to give me feedback by writing a review or messaging me on our Discord channel.

notes.content:
Hello Mad Miner players or followers!

As you know, there are no enemies in Mad Miner. We rely on our hunger, thirst or oxygen to survive. These 3 vital factors keep us busy enough.

My question for you is: Should enemies be added to our mines to add action to Mad Miner? 

You decide this update. If you approve it, it will be added, if you don't approve it, it won't be added.

You can participate in the voting [url=https://forms.gle/CWVqpr1AF157XPuo6]here[/url]. Thank you in advance for your time.

notes.title: V1.1 UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone from Mad Miner's first major update![/h3]

Thank you for playing Mad Miner or adding it to your wishlist. This interest greatly influences my motivation to develop Mad Miner. It makes me very happy to see people interested in my game. I hope Mad Miner is a game that deserves your playing time.

Without further ado, I would like to explain step by step what awaits you in this big update.

If you're ready, sit back, fasten your seatbelts and hold on tight!

[h3]Major Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Our mines are now accompanied by [b]water[/b]! For this reason, a third vital factor comes into play and we start to feel thirsty. Thanks to water, we produce [b]water pots[/b], [b]water our crops[/b], [b]fish [/b]and [b]make our soils to muddy[/b].
[*]A total of 20 new buildings, 5 new buildings in each mine, are being added to our mines. These structures sometimes reward us, sometimes make us think, and sometimes just sit there. But it greatly increases our sense of discovery!
[*]With the new inventory layout, we can access our items under categories. In this way, we stop getting lost among hundreds of items.
[*]We will now be able to produce our items with [b]a single click![/b] You remember that we need to place three different materials to craft items on the crafting table. Instead of sending those materials to the production table one by one, they will be placed automatically when you click on the item you want to produce with the "right mouse button". This way you won't have to memorize the recipes!
[*]From now on, your lives will come into play when you run out of any vital factor (thirsty, lack of oxygen or hunger). In this way, you will avoid dying suddenly, and if you want, you will be able to delay it further thanks to the "[b]health increase[/b]" development.
[*]Mad Miner's food is taking a radical change for the first time. While before you could not consume food other than canned foods, now you will be able to drink [b]soups[/b]. For this reason, while soups will be your meals that you consume at an earlier time, canned foods will be a more difficult to produce and more filling meal option. In addition, the canning machine for canned food should produce empty cans; For soups, you must produce empty plates at the ingredient table.
[*]I told you that a new character would join us. Gamblers now accompany us in the deserts. Thanks to this NPC, we will be able to spin a wheel with four different prizes at the same time in exchange for 1 shiny gold bar. The rewards he gives are not bad!
[/list]

And I list the others in short bullet points:

[list]
[*]Bat.
[*]Seed Production Table.
[*]Fishing Rods and Fisherman's Table.
[*]Fish Soup and Canned Fish.
[*]10 new soundtracks designed entirely for Mad Miner. These music were created by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Batu]Nervio Music[/url].
[*]4 new building blocks available from the Patcher Box.
[*]Soil, Mud, Empty Pot and Empty Flowerpot.
[*]Potter's Table.
[*]Wild crops.
[*]Binoculars.
[*]Wall Candle and Torch.
[*]Traders following us.
[*]Ability to swim in water and petroleum.
[*]New clothes for our character.
[*]Stone Ladder.
[*]Wooden, stone and iron doors.
[*]Rope Bridge.
[*]4 new statues obtainable through mine ladders.
[*]Change the intensity of shadows thanks to a new setting.
[*]Smoke effect when item is placed.
[*]Details added to the character when oxygen resistance and hunger resistance improvements are completed.
[/list]

Minor features changed/added with this version:

[list]
[*]The elevator drawing has changed.
[*]The design of the information box showing the purchased items has been changed.
[*]The color of the box showing item descriptions has changed.
[*]The production of the oxygen machine and tube has changed.
[*]Added fire sound to lanterns and torches.
[*]Tutorial made a little more detailed.
[*]Furnaces have been added to be returned to the inventory when broken.
[*]The satiety rates of canned food have been increased.
[*]The production of canned foods with special effects has been made easier.
[*]Added diary to be open at startup.
[*]Additional information showing in which mode the saved mines in the record loading menu are recorded.
[*]The storage limit for pickaxes has been removed.
[*]Dynamite destroys everything now.
[*]Some floor designs have been redrawn.
[*]The boxes of all interacted items have been redesign.
[/list]

Bugs fixed with this version:

[list]
[*]When put into Builder mode, unfinished upgrades were locked as if they were completed when you loaded your saved mine.
[*]The game would open and close again when the language was changed.
[*]Some buildings did not destroy the walls behind them. For this reason, the wall shadows were disappearing.
[*]When tables that were not crafting or material tables were broken, they were returned to the inventory as production or material tables.
[*]Ladders were not spawn in mining cities.
[*]Rail line formations coincided with mining cities.
[*]And many minor bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

And some images:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/e5178a97b24841efe4e4ca041652895a538f4f27.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/126b6c1931a5ac8130ed1c89ee54ac7746e54afd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/91a6308023d5205bce1d1dab1a4a900596097294.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/beaf08d0a3b96bd517b04d0f040df6508f853071.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/3768cffd5fd443334adb58c13fbd79a5462ec136.png[/img]

I hope you have an even better time with the V1.1 update. I will rest a little and follow your comments. Please let me know your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DbvwGd2sT8]Discord [/url]server or by writing a review.

Also, I would like to thanks EAF156thTFWAS, who is a Mad Miner player and has rewritten the Japanese translation.

Have fun playing, lots of digging!

-Samet

notes.title: V1.1 COMING SOON [NOV 21]
notes.content:
Hello everyone from the second announcement of V1.1!

Thank you for giving Mad Miner a chance. I can guess that you have been playing Mad Miner for hours and now you are looking for a new excitement. That's why I'm adding content that will enable you to play much more enjoyable and for much longer hours with V1.1.

Let's take a look at some of the features that will be available very soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/531f2cd91ff7a6947b0f76c831e7ea62336ab815.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/2b346d3d73e04571e7d8dce4c6d8059eff9e233e.png[/img]

I mentioned before that fishing rods were included in the game. When you take your fishing rod and throw it towards the water, it looks exactly like the 1st image, while in the 2nd image you see the interface where you can fish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/b831679f4408b36ec300d564dbd6319530014fa1.png[/img]

There have been some drastic changes in our food system. While soups are now included in the game, canned meals have turned into a luxury meal option. You need bowls to produce soups, and cans to produce canned meals. However, since canned food is not as simple as bowls, you will need the "Canning Machine" you see in the image. This machine will allow you to produce canned food professionally. In this way, canned food will be one of your more luxurious and more filling meal options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/b845783b82699b7c08d5e76e5bbc07399b945e28.png[/img]

When you produce mine ladders and travel to new mines, the statues that you cannot get more than once have landed in the Mad Miner mines. These statues cannot be crafted or collected. In this way, you will be able to obtain them once and display them in your most special corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/4436f6e9760b1981526b9d91d0f044e4ae809597.png[/img]

I said that the most important element of this update is "water". Thanks to the water, you will both quench your thirst and use it to grow your crops as you see in the image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/2fc8001ab793c7344b814884dfe0af466e4b7af2.png[/img]

Even though water has made some things harder to produce or directly added a thirst factor, dying will not be as simple as before. As you can see in the image, when you run out of a vital factor, your [b]lives[/b] will come into play and you will be able to survive until they run out. These hearts can be increased up to 6 hearts thanks to a skill. In this way, you can postpone dying and enjoy Mad Miner.

Except from the features I have described, new structures accompany the mines. Although I do not share these structures to avoid spoiling the excitement, I announced one of them on our Discord server. In order not to miss these announcements, you can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/DbvwGd2sT8]Discord[/url] server.

Thank you for following Mad Miner.

-Samet

notes.title: V1.1: LATEST STATUS
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you have enjoyed or are enjoying playing Mad Miner. I had announced that I was working on the new major update for Mad Miner. So, how's it going? Let me tell you right away.

First and foremost, the "water" will be the essential element of this version. That's why I've incorporated water and its basic physics into Mad Miner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/3226b5546234269ce8629a1e3c4b4650edbd3aa2.png[/img]

You must have also noticed the fishing rod in the hands of our miner :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/e3c453967512642f7d551c54c9590c79c69d8aaa.png[/img]

With V1.1, you will encounter wild crops underground. This will allow you to both cook canned food and produce seeds with the "seed production table." Yes! We will now be able to produce our own seeds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/31c9768f8b8c8e0e4fd1607e3a5b6c80c21e8900.png[/img]

Apart from these features, there are also additions such as bats, categorization in the inventory interface, binoculars, and fixes for some formations. (I admit progress has been slow due to the very hot weather :D)

The V1.1 update will be quite enjoyable and a bit more detailed. There's still a lot more to add. So, don't forget to stay tuned.

Note: Mines are cool, escaping to the Mad Miner mines might be a good solution in this heat :P

-Samet

notes.title: V1.1 UPDATE PLAN
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44196714/219b0944b84686444aaa05bef19cf10e1a6164a7.png[/img]

I hope you enjoy playing Mad Miner. Because with the V1.1 update, some innovations that will double your enjoyment are under development to be included in the game.

If Mad Miner continues to receive the necessary attention; I will be adding new updates to the game to make it more advanced and more enjoyable.

One of the next big updates is [b]V1.1[/b]!

Let's take a look at what this update promises:

[list]
[*]A third survival challenge will be added thanks to a new resource.
[*]Significant things will be achieved thanks to some new tables.
[*]It will be getting harder to fill our stomach.
[*]Cultivating crops will become a little more detailed.
[*]Although our struggle for life is getting harder in general, dying will not be as easy and simple as it used to be.
[*]A new animal will accompany us in our mines.
[*]New structures will accompany the mines that we are currently able to go to.
[*]A new NPC will join our mines.
[*]Some NPCs will can now move around and roam in mines.
[*]Polishing will be done to increase the player experience.
[/list]
I hope this list has sparked your excitement and further increased your interest in Mad Miner.

I wish you good luck in the mines while I work on the update.

-Samet
